about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages packages/media-composition (the original package, at its last commit on the branch checked out; files the package holds only as uncommitted edits are not carried). Each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths.

calls.means: A lower-third fixture named a real person; a public tree holds made-up names only.
A path on one person's computer names that person; the path is made relative to the repository folder it was in.
A path in one person's home folder; made relative.

The test refuses source that names one founder, brand or folder; the names it listed are a real person's and a real folder's, so the list holds placeholder words that no source contains. Put the names of the person's own brand and folders back when this test runs against a private copy.
A path into the maker's private notes, named as notes/ instead.

files.replaces: the older copy of this file this folder held (from old Trillion's parts/media-composition), which lacked `placementPreview` (the drop-preview marker on a lane)

held.tools/media-composition/do-work/__tests_: bundles do-work/build-edit-decisions.ts, which still imports `@/packages/media-composition/...`, `@/packages/content-media-evidence/...` and `#workspace-records` (the old app's import map); none resolves in this tree
same chain as author-edit-decision: `@/packages/media-composition/...`, `@/packages/content-media-evidence/...` and `#workspace-records` do not resolve here
build-overlay-render-descriptor.ts imports `@bitfield/runtime-kit/protocol`, the retired package runtime; the process-source call needs the records-door form
imports `ajv`, which this repository does not depend on; with ajv added it checks the EDL binding against the package's JSON schema

written for the older cut-and-caption.mjs that exported `wordsOf` and `captionLinesForCut` itself; this tree's version takes a caption style and exports `styleFromArgument`, the helpers live in read-data/caption-lines.ts
reads the package's things-to-store-and-run.json and runtime/local-video-renderer/runtime-artifact.json (the local container runtime descriptor of the retired package runtime); neither is carried
held.tools/media-composition/read-data/__test: written for auto-reframe.mjs with `smoothTrack`; this tree's version plans a camera (`planCamera`, read-data/reframe-camera.json) and has no `smoothTrack`
expects the beat split decisions to cut a clip into one piece per beat; against this tree's compose-timeline.ts the clip stays whole (not investigated further)
expects a scene cut to split the source clip in two; against this tree's compose-timeline.ts the clip stays whole, the same drift as beat-sync
written for a numeric karaoke `shadow`; this tree's author-karaoke-captions.mjs takes a shadow object (x, y, blur, spread, colour, opacity)
one case (the follow-track spotlight) fails against this tree's effect-registry.mjs; the other cases of the file were not run apart from it
needs the package `motion-analysis`'s detect_subject_track.py and a reframe that takes no source size; neither is in this tree
